whatsnew: Regime this week: a RATE-DRIVEN de-rating of long-duration tech and semiconductors - not a broad selloff. The 30-yr Treasury yield hit its highest in nearly two decades, compressing high-multiple names, while healthcare and energy led.
Top-scoring names now: XOM (B+), LLY (B+), JPM (B+), MELI (B), GOOGL (B). Bottom: VST, BA, RKLB.

AI-power names took the most rate damage: Vistra (VST) now sits on its 52-week low and Constellation (CEG) low in its range as the long end spiked.
Two forward events dominate next week: NVDA earnings (Aug 26) and Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech (Aug 28) - both can set the tone for the September Fed meeting.
